related.title: 風機變槳軸承與驅動系統
related.titleEn: Wind Turbine Pitch Bearings and Drives
related.transfer: 可遷移「風功率與功率係數」與「風速誤差與功率不確定度」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；風機變槳軸承與驅動系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Wind power and power coefficient" and "Wind-speed error and power uncertainty" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Wind Turbine Pitch Bearings and Drives must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦讓機艙對準風向的系統：偏航誤差的損失、驅動器數量、電纜解纜與尾流導引；風機變槳軸承與驅動系統則以把葉片轉到正確角度的機構：葉片軸承的滾珠載重、微幅擺動、收槳能量與變槳速率為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the system that points the nacelle into the wind: loss from yaw error, number of drives, cable untwisting and wake steering; Wind Turbine Pitch Bearings and Drives centres on the mechanism that turns blades to the right angle: ball loads in blade bearings, small oscillations, feathering energy and pitch rate, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「掃掠面積與比功率」與「掃掠面積與比功率」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「偏航驅動器的數量」的模型移到風機變槳軸承與驅動系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「變槳速率與收槳時間」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Swept area and specific power" and "Swept area and specific power".
Move the model of "The number of yaw drives" to Wind Turbine Pitch Bearings and Drives, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Pitch rate and time to feather", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「風功率與功率係數」與「風速誤差與功率不確定度」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；風機變槳軸承與驅動系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Wind power and power coefficient" and "Wind-speed error and power uncertainty" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Wind Turbine Pitch Bearings and Drives must be respecified.

related.title: 風機齒輪箱狀態監測
related.transfer: 可遷移「風功率與功率係數」與「風速誤差與功率不確定度」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；風機齒輪箱狀態監測的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Wind power and power coefficient" and "Wind-speed error and power uncertainty" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Wind Turbine Gearbox Condition Monitoring must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦讓機艙對準風向的系統：偏航誤差的損失、驅動器數量、電纜解纜與尾流導引；風機齒輪箱狀態監測則以在故障擴大前聽出齒輪箱的問題：總速比、嚙合頻率、軸承缺陷頻率與提早預警的價值為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the system that points the nacelle into the wind: loss from yaw error, number of drives, cable untwisting and wake steering; Wind Turbine Gearbox Condition Monitoring centres on hearing gearbox trouble before it grows: overall ratio, mesh frequency, bearing defect frequencies and the value of early warning, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「掃掠面積與比功率」與「掃掠面積與比功率」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「偏航驅動器的數量」的模型移到風機齒輪箱狀態監測，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「疲勞循環數」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Swept area and specific power" and "Swept area and specific power".
Move the model of "The number of yaw drives" to Wind Turbine Gearbox Condition Monitoring, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Number of fatigue cycles", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「風功率與功率係數」與「風速誤差與功率不確定度」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；風機齒輪箱狀態監測的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Wind power and power coefficient" and "Wind-speed error and power uncertainty" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Wind Turbine Gearbox Condition Monitoring must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 風機偏航系統與控制
history.titleEn: Wind Turbine Yaw Systems and Control
history.text: 1980 年早期小型風機以尾舵被動對風；1990 年主動偏航成為大型風機的標準配備；2015 年機艙光達用於校正偏航誤差；2019 年尾流導引進行商業風場的現場驗證。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 1980: Early small turbines faced the wind passively with tail vanes. 1990: Active yaw became standard on large turbines. 2015: Nacelle lidar came into use for correcting yaw error. 2019: Wake steering was validated in the field at commercial farms. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
